title: Microsoft Teams: customise the recording and transcription notification text
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, admin paths, commands and licensing description are supported. It accurately distinguishes the documented meeting experience from uncertain call support and flags the PowerShell references' release warning.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes admins customizing part of recording and transcription notifications during Teams calls.
claims.quote: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

claims.claim: Admins can customize the meeting recording and transcription consent message.
claims.quote: IT admins can customize the Recording and Transcription message and the URL of the privacy policy used to notify implicitly or gain explicit consent from meeting participants

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Admins can change the privacy policy URL.
claims.quote: Resource (Privacy policy) URL (#4): Only the URL can be changed.

claims.claim: The privacy policy link's display text is fixed.
claims.quote: The display text "Privacy policy" is fixed and cannot be modified.

claims.claim: Teams displays a notification banner when recording or transcription starts.
claims.quote: When recording or transcription starts, Teams displays a notification banner composed of four elements.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The banner consent message supports plain text and HTML links.
claims.quote: Consent message (#3): Supports plain text and HTML <a> tags for adding multiple custom links.

claims.claim: In explicit-consent meetings, the consent dialog appears when a user unmutes or turns on the camera.
claims.quote: For meetings that require explicit consent, Teams displays a consent dialog when a user unmutes/turns on the camera.

claims.claim: The consent dialog's custom consent message allows plain text only.
claims.quote: Customizable consent message (#3): Only supports plain text, HTML <a> tag is not supported.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Custom messages are entered per scenario and language in a CSV template.
claims.quote: Download the CSV template from the customization panel. Open the downloaded template, and fill in your custom messages for each scenario and language as needed.

claims.claim: The scenarios distinguish initiators and participants and implicit and explicit consent.
claims.quote: initiator_implicit: For users who start recording or transcription in an implicit consent meeting. participant_implicit: For users who join an implicit consent meeting where another participant started recording or transcription.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Each custom message is limited to 200 characters.
claims.quote: Custom messages can't exceed 200 characters; longer messages aren't permitted.

claims.claim: Fixed information, including the initiator's name and privacy policy, is always included.
claims.quote: The message you set appears in the notification for the corresponding scenarios, along with fixed information (such as the initiator's name and privacy policy) that is always included.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment; controls[2].note; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn's feature page says custom messages are not supported in 1:1 calls.
claims.quote: Custom messages are not supported in 1:1 calls.

claims.claim: Learn does not explain how custom notification messages apply to group calls.
claims.quote: Searched: custom recording transcription notification group calls. Read feature page, recording-transcription-overview, call-recording-transcription-captions and Copilot release notes; none specifies group-call custom-message behavior.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the custom notification setting is on or off by default in meeting or calling policies.
claims.quote: Searched: EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage default; Teams custom recording transcription notification default enabled disabled. Read feature page and meeting/calling policy references: parameter default None is not a statement of the service's initial enabled state.

claims.claim: No source states that existing notifications change without administrators configuring custom wording.
claims.quote: Searched: custom recording transcription notification default enabled disabled; EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage default. Read feature page, policy references and November 17 Copilot release notes; none states existing notifications automatically change.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Teams uses its default message when no custom message exists for a language or scenario.
claims.quote: If there's no custom message for a specific language or scenario, the user sees the default message in Teams.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature documents notification wording and URL changes, not new data access or changes to captured recording/transcription content.
claims.quote: Searched: recording-transcription-custom-message permissions role data access recording stop mobile. Read feature page, recording-transcription-overview and custom-message cmdlet references; no new data access or changed recording content is documented.

claims.claim: Learn describes no new permission, identity or sign-in behavior for custom notification messages.
claims.quote: Searched: recording-transcription-custom-message permissions role data access recording stop mobile. Read the feature page, New-CsTeamsRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage and policy references; no new permission, execution identity or sign-in behavior is described.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Custom messages apply to meetings organized by users assigned the enabled meeting policy.
claims.quote: Once the custom message is enabled for a meeting policy, all users assigned to that policy see the custom notifications in meetings they organize.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: All participants in those meetings follow the organizer's custom-message settings.
claims.quote: All participants in those meetings follow the organizer's custom message settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The custom-message setting changes notification strings rather than starting, stopping or blocking recording or transcription.
claims.quote: This policy controls whether custom strings can be shown for recording and transcription in user's Teams meetings. It need to work with RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier.

claims.claim: Putting <empty> in a scenario/language displays only fixed information.
claims.quote: If you don't want to display any message (excluding the fixed information), you can insert `<empty>` for the specific language or scenario. In this case, the notification shows only the fixed information.

claims.claim: Learn supports custom messages on Teams Windows, macOS and Web clients.
claims.quote: Custom messages are supported on Teams Windows, macOS, and Web clients.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: iOS and Android currently support plain text only, with full customizability described as coming soon.
claims.quote: iOS and Android currently support plain text only, with full message customizability coming soon.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not dated full message customizability on iOS and Android.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams custom recording transcription notification iOS Android full customizability release date. Read feature page and returned release-note excerpts; the feature page says coming soon without a date and no result supplies one.

claims.claim: Excel can cause CSV formatting problems in some non-English system languages.
claims.quote: In some non-English system languages (for example, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and other European locales), Excel uses a different default CSV delimiter based on regional settings.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft tells admins using those system languages to edit the CSV in a plain text editor rather than Excel.
claims.quote: To avoid formatting issues, admins using these system languages should edit the CSV template using another plain text editor. Please do not edit or re-save the CSV file using Excel.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A Teams license is required to use Teams, except for joining meetings anonymously.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included under the product-level Teams license, with no feature-specific additional requirement asserted.
claims.quote: You manage access to Teams at the user level by assigning or removing a Microsoft Teams product license. Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No additional license requirement specific to custom notifications is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: recording-transcription-custom-message license Premium; Teams custom recording transcription notification licensing Premium. Read feature page, user-access, Teams add-on licenses and Teams Premium comparison tables; none names an additional license for custom notification messages.

claims.claim: Other recording/transcription-related options have Teams Premium or Copilot licensing requirements, not stated to apply to custom notifications.
claims.quote: Intelligent recap for meetings (Teams Premium and Microsoft Copilot) | Licensing and the transcription policy control this feature. Users with a Teams Premium or Microsoft Copilot license automatically have access to this feature.

claims.claim: Displayed custom wording depends on the participant's client language.
claims.quote: The message displayed depends on the scenario and the participant's client language. If there's no custom message for a specific language or scenario, the user sees the default message in Teams.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The customization panel supports uploading the completed CSV.
claims.quote: Upload the completed CSV using the Select a file button. Use the Preview button to see how your changes appear.

claims.claim: The feature follows meeting-policy assignment, including policies assigned to users or groups.
claims.quote: To learn more about assigning policies to both users and groups in your organization, see Assign policies to users and groups.

claims.claim: The toggle is in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Navigate to Meetings → Meeting policies. Select or create a meeting policy where you want to enable custom messages. In the Recording & transcription section, find the new setting: Show customized in-meeting notification for recording and transcription.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage $true sets the meeting-policy custom-message switch, subject to the briefing's PowerShell release warning.
claims.quote: [-EnableRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage <Boolean>] This policy controls whether custom strings can be shown for recording and transcription in user's Teams meetings. It need to work with RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier.

claims.claim: Message editing is reached in Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Customize notification.
claims.quote: Navigate to Meetings → Meeting policies. Select or create a meeting policy where you want to enable custom messages. In the Recording & transcription section ... Click the Customize notification button to set your custom message.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessageIdentifier <guid> selects the custom message set, subject to the documented release warning.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. This attribute holds the unique identifier for the custom recording and transcription meeting message. It stores a GUID that points to the CustomMessage in TeamsCustomMessageConfiguration.

claims.claim: New-CsTeamsRecordingAndTranscriptionCustomMessage creates the custom message set.
